summary: Strengthen risk assessment, control assurance, and committee reporting with ISO 31000 and IEC 31010 practice. Explore the five-day course.
lede: Enterprise risk assessment helps experienced analysts, advisers and control specialists link exposures to causes, controls and decisions. The training develops structured assessment through risk taxonomy and cause mapping, scenario analysis, control assurance, and appetite and key risk indicator thresholds, with practice drafting escalation briefs and risk committee reports.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for experienced practitioners who assess enterprise exposures, test controls, maintain risk information, or report changing conditions to risk committees.
prerequisites: This advanced course suits you if you have working knowledge of enterprise risk management, risk assessment, or internal controls. You should be able to interpret a risk register and discuss likelihood, impact, and control ownership. No coding or programming is required.
